slices.title: Phase-progress observability for generate_scene
slices.intent: generate_scene calls onUpdate at five phase boundaries with messages of the form generate_scene phase <name>. The runner maps tool_execution_update partialResult.message onto the durable trace channel via traceMessageForUpdate. The workbench rail regexes learn the new vocabulary beside the legacy patterns. User stories 1 and 2.

symbols.name: buildGenerationTools
symbols.expectation: generate_scene.execute accepts the fourth onUpdate parameter and calls it at five phase boundaries: content start, content done, actions start, actions done, persist. Messages use the form generate_scene phase <name>. All existing validation paths and results stay unchanged.

symbols.name: traceMessageForUpdate
symbols.expectation: Maps a pi tool_execution_update whose partialResult.message is a non-empty string to that message, and null otherwise.

symbols.name: sceneProgress
symbols.expectation: The rail regexes gain the alternatives generate_scene phase content, generate_scene phase actions, and generate_scene phase persist. The existing alternatives generating content, llm[scene-content, generating actions, and llm[scene-actions stay.

deficiencies: traceMessageForUpdate signature deviates. Expected (update: ToolExecutionUpdateEvent): { message: string } | null. Actual (update: { partialResult?: unknown; }): { message: string } | null. The expected type ToolExecutionUpdateEvent is not defined in the codebase and the delivered parameter type is an inline structural type. Align the delivered signature with the captured postcondition or re-capture the postcondition to the structural form.

slices.title: Watchdog progress-reset heartbeat and fetch-layer cap fix
slices.intent: withAgentToolTimeout resets the deadline timer to the base timeoutMs whenever the wrapped tool calls onUpdate, capped by a hard ceiling of 3 times the base. The abort text keeps the stable fragment execution budget and was aborted at any budget value. The undici headersTimeout and bodyTimeout are raised or disabled on the LLM fetch path so a silent provider cannot fail the fetch at 300 s. User story 3.

symbols.name: withAgentToolTimeout
symbols.expectation: Deadline resets on onUpdate below the 3x ceiling; updates after settle still dropped; caller abort wins the race; zero-progress tools abort at base; abort text keeps the fragment execution budget and was aborted at any budget value.

slices.expectation: A tool that reports progress every few minutes exceeds the base budget and still completes. A tool that reports no progress still aborts at the base budget. A tool that reports progress past the ceiling aborts at the ceiling with the message containing execution budget and was aborted. Caller cancellation still aborts immediately with AgentToolAbortedError. A scene-generation fetch survives provider byte pauses beyond 300 s.
